title: garage sale goblin
pitch: buy a haunted lamp for $9, sell it to a ghost for $70, pay rent to a bigger goblin.
controls: tap or click items and buttons; drag the slider or tap - / + to set your price. keyboard: 1-5 pick an item, arrows or -/+ nudge the price (shift = 5), enter = main button, t = take their offer, esc = back / no sale, 1/2 = pick a street. sound on/off button in the top bar (saved).
how_to: buy junk at yard sales. drag the slider and watch the seller's face before you offer.
back at the shop, haggle each customer up. push too hard and they walk.
rare items glow purple. cursed ones bite overnight unless you sell them fast.
pay rent every few days or the bigger goblin evicts you.
